paragraphs: Keysight Technologies, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "Keysight" or "the company"), incorporated in Delaware on December 6, 2013, is a global innovator in the computing, communications and electronics markets, committed to advancing our customers' business success by helping them solve critical challenges in the development and commercialization of their products and services. Our mission, "accelerating innovation to connect and secure the world," speaks to the value we provide our customers in a world of ever-increasing technological complexity. We deliver this value through a broad range of design and test solutions that enable our customers to bring their innovations to market on ever-shorter schedules.

Keysight's portfolio of hardware, software, and services enables our customers' workflows as they design, validate, manufacture, deploy, and optimize their products and solutions. Our revenue is derived primarily from solutions addressing research and development ("R&D") applications, and to a lesser degree, applications in manufacturing and operations. The accelerating pace of technological innovation and engineering intensity are long-term secular drivers of demand for Keysight's solutions and services. We serve a global set of customers in over 100 countries across a wide range of industry segments, including communications, aerospace, defense, and government, automotive, energy, industrial, general electronics, and semiconductor.

We generated $5.4 billion, $5.0 billion, and $5.5 billion of revenue in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Revenue, income from operations, and assets by business segment as of and for the fiscal years ended October 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, are provided in Note 16, "Segment Information," to our consolidated financial statements.

We trace our heritage back over 80 years to the beginning of Silicon Valley. The fundamental elements of our culture are represented in our Keysight Leadership Model ("KLM"), which provides a framework for sustained value creation for customers, shareholders, and employees. The KLM centers on delivering customer success via a continuous activity system and core values that guide and drive our actions as a company and as individuals. The activities are summarized as an ongoing cycle

of market insight that drives capital allocation and yields timely solutions that are optimized via operational excellence. More information on the KLM can be found at https://about.keysight.com/en/companyinfo/leadership.shtml.

Keysight conducts business globally with approximately 40,000 end customers each year, including many Fortune 1000 companies that are developing new electronic technologies, networks, systems, devices, and components. The following advantages enable us to deliver on our commitment of sustained value creation for our stakeholders.
Deep, long-term, global customer relationships

Keysight's history of collaborative innovation is demonstrated by our engagement with leading companies across the diverse markets that we address. Our customers trust Keysight to deliver the technological expertise, leading-edge capabilities, and broad solutions portfolio that they need to achieve their product development goals. Keysight employs a comprehensive global direct sales channel with experienced management and highly technical sales and application engineers, including a strong local presence in both developed and emerging markets. These sales personnel are supported by close collaboration with the engineering teams who create the solutions used by our customers so that problems can be addressed efficiently, and solutions enhanced quickly, to enable customer success.

Our legacy of over 80 years of contribution in measurement science and the resulting breadth of our products and solutions yields a large, global installed base. This base of customers complements our large and growing services portfolio, and offers additional sales opportunities as requirements evolve and customers upgrade their solutions over time.
Unique technology expertise and capabilities

Keysight is a technology-driven company, investing in R&D to align our business with available markets and position the company for growth. As our customers' trusted test and measurement partner, we innovate at the leading edge of the technologies they deploy in their electronic systems under development. We employ a combination of strategies to lead in this area, including engagement with top standards bodies and industry consortia and close collaboration with top research programs in universities and industry. Our central R&D team, Keysight Labs, focuses on developing breakthrough hardware and software technologies that are deployed in application-specific contexts by our business engineering teams. We develop and incorporate proprietary semiconductor and packaging technologies to deliver differentiated performance within our industry.
Differentiated, first-to-market solutions portfolio

Keysight's industry-focused organizational structure emphasizes our engagement with leading customers across our end markets. We use insights gained from these relationships, together with our technology expertise, to identify market opportunities and seek to maximize the lifecycle value, beginning in R&D. Our development teams leverage the broad array of Keysight hardware, software, and services, adding new capability as necessary, to create market-leading solutions. Providing leading-edge, application-focused solutions for our customers in sync with their project schedules is key to our differentiation and value delivery and facilitates the continuous advancement of electronics technology. With a software- and customer-centric focus, we continue to make strategic investments to expand the R&D component of our revenue mix and grow the software and services content of our business, which has the added benefit of increasing recurring revenue.

Our operating model incorporates cost structure flexibility that has allowed Keysight to deliver profitability across a range of economic and market conditions. We employ variable pay mechanisms across our entire employee population and complement this with the strategic use of contingent staffing. We have a diversified go-to-market approach with indirect sales partners and electronic commerce to complement our direct sales force. This approach provides flexibility with the added benefit of expanding our reach and providing more efficient and effective transactional purchase capability. We use a centralized order fulfillment organization that supplies solutions to customers worldwide, allowing us to leverage the scale of our business to provide high-quality products while maintaining competitive margins. We complement our in-house capabilities with an extensive network of suppliers and subcontractors, which allows us to adapt to changing market conditions. The durability and resilience of our business model has provided strategic flexibility and enabled the company to continue to allocate capital and invest in growth through different market environments.

headings: Risks, Uncertainties and Other Factors That May Affect Future Results
Volatility and uncertainty in general economic conditions may adversely affect our operating results and financial condition.
Economic, political, and other risks associated with international sales and operations could adversely affect our results of operations.
Economic and political policies favoring national interests could adversely affect our results of operations.
Volatile geopolitical turmoil, including popular uprisings, regional conflicts, terrorism and war could result in market instability, which could negatively impact our business results.
Our operating results and financial condition could be harmed if the markets into which we sell our solutions decline or do not grow as anticipated.
A decreased demand for our customers' products or trade barriers or restrictions could adversely affect our results of operations.
Our future operating results may fluctuate significantly if our investments in innovative technologies are not as profitable as we anticipate.
Failure to adjust our purchases due to changing market conditions or failure to estimate our customers' demand could adversely affect our income.
Our operating results may suffer if our manufacturing capacity does not match the demand for our solutions.
Key customers or large orders may expose us to additional business and legal risks that could have a material adverse impact on our operating results and financial condition.
Industry consolidation and consolidation among our customer base may lead to increased competition and may harm our operating results.
Our acquisitions, strategic alliances, joint ventures, internal reorganizations and divestitures may result in financial results that are different than expected.
Any inability to complete acquisitions on acceptable terms could negatively impact our growth rate and financial performance.
We have outstanding debt and may incur other debt in the future, which could adversely affect our financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.
Volatility in currency exchange rates could adversely impact our financial results.
Our effective tax rate may be adversely impacted by changes in our business mix or changes in the tax legislative landscape.
If tax laws or incentives change or cease to be in effect, our income taxes could increase significantly.

If we suffer a loss to our factories, facilities or distribution system due to a catastrophic event, including events caused by the effects of climate change, our operations could be significantly harmed.

Our commitment to net zero emissions in company operations by fiscal year 2040 will be subject to significant costs and regulations, which could impact business operations, processes, revenue, and reputation.
Third parties may claim that we are infringing their intellectual property rights, and we could suffer significant litigation or licensing expenses or be prevented from selling solutions or services.
Third parties may infringe our intellectual property rights, and we may suffer competitive injury or expend significant resources enforcing our intellectual property rights.
If we experience a significant cybersecurity attack or disruption in our IT systems or our products, our business, reputation, and operating results could be adversely affected.
Our business is exposed to risks associated with the use of AI tools.
Our business will suffer if we are not able to retain and hire key personnel.
If we fail to maintain satisfactory compliance with certain regulations, we may be subject to substantial negative financial consequences and civil or criminal penalties.
paragraphs: Our business is sensitive to negative changes in general economic conditions, both inside and outside the U.S. Global and regional economic volatility and uncertainty, inflation and potential recession has and may continue to impact our business, resulting in:
•increased cost to manufacture products or deliver solutions; •reduced customer purchasing power;
•reduced demand for our solutions and services and reduced, delayed or canceled orders; •increased risk of excess and obsolete inventory;
•increased risk of supply chain shortages; •increased price pressure on our solutions and services; and
•greater risk of impairment to the value, and a detriment to the liquidity, of our future investment portfolio.

In addition, global and regional macroeconomic developments, such as uncertainty related to future economic activity, increased tariff rates and reciprocal tariffs, volatility in financial and capital markets, reduced access to credit, changing interest rates, decreased liquidity, uncertain or destabilizing national elections and reactions to national election results, political violence and unrest in the U.S., the U.K., Europe, and Asia, and negative changes or volatility in general economic conditions in those regions could negatively affect our ability to conduct business in those territories. Financial difficulties experienced by our suppliers and customers due to economic volatility could result in product delays, reduced purchasing power, delays in payment or inability to pay us, and inventory issues. Economic risks related to accounts receivable could result in delays in collection and greater bad debt expense.

paragraphs: Keysight Technologies, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "Keysight" or "the company"), incorporated in Delaware on December 6, 2013, is a global innovator in the computing, communications and electronics markets, committed to advancing our customers' business success by helping them solve critical challenges in the development and commercialization of their products and services. Our mission, "accelerating innovation to connect and secure the world," speaks to the value we provide our customers in a world of ever-increasing technological complexity. We deliver this value through a broad range of design and test solutions that address the critical challenges our customers face in bringing their innovations to market on ever-shorter schedules.
Our fiscal year end is October 31. Unless otherwise stated, all years and dates refer to our fiscal year.
Acquisitions of Spirent Communications plc, Synopsys' Optical Solutions Group, and Ansys' PowerArtist RTL Business

On October 15, 2025, we acquired all of the outstanding common stock of Spirent Communications plc ("Spirent") for $1,415 million, net of $127 million cash acquired, using existing cash. On October 16, 2025, Keysight divested Spirent's high-speed ethernet, network security, and channel emulation business lines for $399 million to Viavi Solutions Inc. ("Viavi") in connection with satisfying the regulatory conditions set out as part of the Spirent acquisition. For the year ended October 31, 2025, our acquisition of Spirent resulted in incremental revenue of $9 million. In our discussion of changes in our results of operations, we have qualitatively disclosed the impact of the Spirent acquisition.

On October 17, 2025, we acquired the Optical Solutions Group business ("OSG") from Synopsys, Inc. ("Synopsys") and the PowerArtist RTL business ("PowerArtist") from Ansys, Inc. ("Ansys") for $578 million and $26 million, respectively. For the year ended October 31, 2025, the acquisitions had an immaterial impact on our revenue.
See Note 2, "Acquisitions," for additional information. Impact of U.S. government tariffs

Beginning in the second quarter of fiscal 2025, the U.S. government announced tariffs on products from most countries and additional reciprocal tariffs on certain countries. In response, China and other countries announced retaliatory tariffs against certain imports from the United States. There have been recent changes effective August 1, 2025, resulting in broad-based increases in tariff rates, and there has been continuing litigation in the federal courts regarding the validity of the imposition of certain tariffs. These tariffs have impacted our financial results for the year ended October 31, 2025. We have taken actions across multiple vectors to reduce the impact on our results of operations. This multipronged mitigation approach spans our global manufacturing footprint and sourcing strategies, as well as pricing and cost actions.
For additional discussion of risks related to tariffs and trade relations, please refer to Part I Item 1A "Risk Factors."
Years ended October 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023

Orders were $5,452 million, $5,033 million, and $5,190 million in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Orders of $5,452 million for 2025 increased 8 percent compared to 2024. Acquisitions had a favorable impact of 1 percentage point on the increase, while foreign currency movements had an immaterial impact. Orders grew across all regions. Orders of $5,033 million for 2024 decreased 3 percent compared to 2023. Acquisitions had a favorable impact of 4 percentage points on the change, while foreign currency movements had an immaterial impact. Orders declined in the Americas and Asia Pacific, while Europe was flat.

Revenue was $5,375 million, $4,979 million, and $5,464 million in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Revenue of $5,375 million for 2025 increased 8 percent compared to 2024. Acquisitions and foreign currency movements had an immaterial impact on the change. Revenue increased in both the Communications Solutions Group ("CSG") and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group ("EISG"). Revenue from CSG and EISG represented approximately 69 percent and 31 percent, respectively, of total revenue for 2025. Revenue of $4,979 million for 2024 decreased 9 percent compared to 2023. Acquisitions had a favorable impact of 3 percentage points on the change, while foreign currency movements had an immaterial impact. Revenue declined in both CSG and EISG. Revenue from CSG and EISG represented approximately 69 percent and 31 percent, respectively, of total revenue for 2024.

Net income was $850 million, $614 million, and $1,057 million in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Net income of $850 million for 2025 increased 38 percent compared to 2024, primarily driven by higher revenue and net gains on equity investments and derivative instruments and lower income tax provisions, partially offset by higher people-related costs, higher acquisition and integration costs, impact of tariffs, and loss from discontinued operations, net of income taxes. Net income of $614 million for 2024 decreased 42 percent compared to 2023, primarily driven by lower revenue and higher acquisition and integration costs, restructuring costs, and amortization of acquisition-related balances, partially offset by lower provision for income taxes, favorable gross margin impact from the ESI Group acquisition, and lower people-related costs.
Cash flows generated from operating activities were $1,409 million, $1,052 million, and $1,408 million in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

paragraphs: Keysight Technologies, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "Keysight" or "the company"), 在華盛頓州註冊成立於2013年12月6日，是一家在全球計算、通訊與電子市場中創新領導者，致力於協助客戶解決產品與服務的開發與商業化過程中的關鍵挑戰，以促進客戶業務的成功。我們的使命，"加速創新，連結並保障世界，" 顯示了我們在技術複雜性不斷增加的時代中，為客戶所提供的價值。我們透過廣泛的設計與測試解決方案來實現此價值，使客戶能更快地將創新產品推向市場。

Keysight 的硬體、軟體與服務組合，協助客戶在設計、驗證、製造、部署與優化其產品與解決方案的過程中進行工作流程。我們的營業收入主要來自於解決研究與開發 ("R&D") 應用的方案，並在較小程度上來自製造與運營應用。技術創新與工程強度的加速進步，是 Keysight 解決方案與服務需求的長期趨勢驅動因素。我們服務於全球超過100個國家的客戶，涵蓋通訊、航空、防禦與政府、汽車、能源、工業、一般電子與半導體等多種產業領域。
我們在2025年、2024年與2023年分別產生了54億美元、50億美元與55億美元的營業收入。截至2025年10月31日財務年度終結，營業收入、營運收入與資產按業務分部的資料，請參閱附註16，"分部資訊"，至我們的合併財務報表。
我們的歷史可追溯至80多年前的矽谷初期。我們文化的基礎元素體現在 Keysight 領導模式 ("KLM")，這為客戶、股東與員工創造持續價值提供了框架。KLM 的核心在於透過持續的活動系統與核心價值觀，來實現客戶成功，這些價值觀引導並驅動我們公司與個人的行動。這些活動總結為一個持續的市場洞察循環
用以驅動資本配置，並產生及時的解決方案，透過運營卓越進行優化。有關 KLM 的更多資訊，請至 https://about.keysight.com/en/companyinfo/leadership.shtml 查閱。
Keysight 透過全球約40,000個終端客戶進行業務，包括許多正在開發新電子技術、網路、系統、設備與零組件的《財富》1000大企業。以下優勢使我們能實現對股東持續價值創造的承諾。
深厚、長期、全球性的客戶關係

Keysight 與我們所服務的多樣市場中領導企業的合作創新歷史，體現了我們的創新合作精神。我們的客戶信任 Keysight 能提供他們所需的技術專業知識、最先進的技術能力與廣泛的解決方案組合，以達成其產品開發目標。Keysight 僱用了一個全面的全球直接銷售通路，擁有經驗豐富的管理團隊與高技術的銷售與應用工程師，包括在已開發與新興市場中均有強大的本地存在。這些銷售人員由與工程團隊的緊密合作所支援，這些工程團隊創造了客戶所使用的解決方案，以確保問題能被高效解決，並能快速改善解決方案，以實現客戶成功。
本公司在測量科學領域超過80年的貢獻，以及由此產生的產品與解決方案廣度，形成了龐大的全球安裝基礎。此客戶基礎與本公司龐大且持續成長的服務組合相輔相成，並在需求演進與客戶升級其解決方案的過程中，提供額外的銷售機會。
獨特的科技專業知識與能力

Keysight 是一家以科技為驅動的公司，投資於研發，以使業務與現有市場對接，並為公司未來成長做準備。作為客戶值得信賴的測試與測量夥伴，我們在客戶在其電子系統開發中所部署的科技領域持續創新。我們採用多種策略以在該領域保持領先，包括與頂級標準機構與產業聯盟的互動，以及與頂級大學與產業研究計畫的緊密合作。本公司核心的研發團隊 Keysight Labs，專注於開發突破性的硬體與軟體科技，並由業務工程團隊在特定應用情境中部署。我們開發並整合專屬的半導體與封裝科技，以在產業中提供差異化的表現。
差異化、首創市場的解決方案組合

Keysight 的產業導向組織架構強調與各終端市場領導客戶的互動。我們利用這些關係所獲得的見解，結合科技專業知識，以識別市場機會，並從研發階段開始，力求最大化產品生命週期價值。我們的開發團隊運用 Keysight 廣泛的硬體、軟體與服務，必要時增加新功能，以創造市場領先的解決方案。為客戶提供與其專案時程同步的領先科技、應用導向解決方案，是本公司差異化與價值交付的關鍵，並促進電子科技的持續進步。以軟體與客戶為中心的關注點，使我們持續進行戰略投資，以擴大研發收入組成的比例，並成長軟體與服務業務內容，這也帶來增加重複性收入的附加好處。

本公司營運模式 incorporates 成本結構的靈活性，使 Keysight 能在不同經濟與市場條件下實現獲利。我們在全體員工中採用變動薪資機制，並以戰略性使用臨時人力作為補充。我們擁有多元化的市場接觸方式，透過間接銷售夥伴與電子商務來補強我們的直接銷售團隊。此方式提供靈活性，並帶來擴大市場覆蓋與更有效率且有效的交易購買能力的附加好處。我們使用集中化的訂單履行組織，為全球客戶提供解決方案，使我們能利用業務規模，提供高品質產品同時維持競爭性毛利率。我們以廣泛的供應商與 subcontractor 網路補強內部能力，使我們能適應變動的市場條件。本公司營運模式的耐用性與韌性，提供了戰略性靈活性，使公司能在不同市場環境中持續配置資金並投資成長。

paragraphs: Keysight Technologies, Inc. ("we," "us," "our," "Keysight" or "the company"), 係於2013年12月6日於特拉華州註冊設立，為全球在計算機、通信及電子市場的創新領導者，致力協助客戶解決產品與服務的開發與商業化過程中的關鍵挑戰，以促進客戶業務的成功。我們的使命為 "加速創新，以連結並保障世界"，反映我們在技術複雜性不斷增加的時代為客戶所提供的價值。我們透過廣泛的設計與測試解決方案，來實現此價值，以應對客戶在縮短上市時程的壓力下所面臨的關鍵挑戰。
我們的會計年度結算日為10月31日。除非另有說明，所有年份與日期均指我們的會計年度。
收購Spirent Communications plc、Synopsys的光學解決方案部門及Ansys的PowerArtist RTL業務

於2025年10月15日，我們以現金14.15億美元，扣除現金1.27億美元，取得Spirent Communications plc ("Spirent") 全部發行普通股。於2025年10月16日，Keysight將Spirent的高速乙太網路、網路安全及通道模擬業務線以3.99億美元出售給Viavi Solutions Inc. ("Viavi")，以符合Spirent收購所設定的法規條件。於2025年10月31日結算年度，我們收購Spirent所產生的增量營業收入為900萬美元。在說明我們營運成果變動的討論中，我們已質性披露Spirent收購的影響。
於2025年10月17日，我們以5.78億美元取得Synopsys, Inc. ("Synopsys") 的光學解決方案部門 ("OSG")，並以2,600萬美元取得Ansys, Inc. ("Ansys") 的PowerArtist RTL業務 ("PowerArtist")。於2025年10月3,1日結算年度，這些收購對我們的營業收入影響為微不足道。
請參閱附註2，"收購"，以取得更多資訊。美國政府關稅的影響

自2025會計年度第二季開始，美國政府宣佈對來自大多數國家的產品徵收關稅，並對某些國家徵收額外的反制關稅。作為回應，中國及其他國家對來自美國的某些進口商品宣佈反制關稅。自2025年8月1日起，有近期生效的變動，導致關稅率大幅提高，同時美國聯邦法院持續進行有關某些關稅是否有效的訴訟。這些關稅已影響我們2025年10月31日結算年度的財務結果。我們已透過多種方式採取行動，以降低對我們營運成果的影響。此多管齊下的緩衝措施涵蓋我們全球製造據點與採購策略，以及價格與成本措施。
如需進一步討論與關稅及貿易關係相關的風險，請參閱第一部分第1A項 "風險因素"。
截至2025年10月31日止之各年
2025年、2024年及2023年之訂單分別為5,452千萬美元、5,033千萬美元及5,190千萬美元。2025年訂單5,452千萬美元較2024年增加8％。併購對增加有正面影響1個百分點，而外幣變動影響微不足道。訂單在所有地區均成長。2024年訂單5,033千萬美元較2023年減少3％。併購對變動有正面影響4個百分點，而外幣變動影響微不足道。訂單在美洲及亞太地區減少，歐洲則持平。

2025年、2024年及2023年之營業收入分別為5,375千萬美元、4,979千萬美元及5,464千萬美元。2025年營業收入5,375千萬美元較2024年增加8％。併購及外幣變動對變動影響微不足道。營業收入在通訊解決方案羣組（"CSG"）及電子工業解決方案羣組（"EISG"）均成長。2025年CSG及EISG之營業收入分別約佔總營業收入之69％及31％。2024年營業收入4,979千萬美元較2023年減少9％。併購對變動有正面影響3個百分點，而外幣變動影響微不足道。CSG及EISG之營業收入均減少。2024年CSG及EISG之營業收入分別約佔總營業收入之69％及31％。

2025年、2024年及2023年之淨收入分別為850千萬美元、614千萬美元及1,057千萬美元。2025年淨收入850千萬美元較2024年增加38％，主要因營業收入增加、權益投資及衍生工具之淨收益增加及所得稅負擔減少，部分抵銷因人力相關成本增加、併購及整合成本增加、關稅影響及已終止營運之損失（已減除所得稅）。2024年淨收入614千萬美元較2023年減少42％，主要因營業收入減少、併購及整合成本增加、重整成本及併購相關餘額之攤銷費用增加，部分抵銷因所得稅負擔減少、ESI Group併購對毛利率之正面影響及人力相關成本減少。
2025年、2024年及2023年之營運活動所產生之現金流量分別為1,409千萬美元、1,052千萬美元及1,408千萬美元。

headings: 風險、不確定性及其他可能影響未來結果的因素
與我們業務相關的風險
總體經濟條件的波動與不確定性可能不利於我們的營運成果與財務狀況。
與國際銷售與營運相關的經濟、政治及其他風險可能不利於我們的營運成果。
偏袒國家利益的經濟與政治政策可能不利於我們的營運成果。
波動的國際政治局勢動盪，包括羣眾起義、區域衝突、恐怖主義與戰爭，可能導致市場不穩定，進而對我們的營運成果產生負面影響。
若我們銷售解決方案的市場成長不如預期或出現衰退，可能對我們的營運成果與財務狀況造成損害。
我們的客戶產品需求減少或貿易壁壘與限制，可能對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司未來營運成果可能因創新科技投資之獲利不如預期而大幅波動。
未能因市場條件變動調整採購或未能準確預估客戶需求，可能對本公司收入造成不利影響。
若本公司製造能力無法與解決方案之需求匹配，營運成果可能受影響。
關鍵客戶或大宗訂單可能使本公司面臨額外之商業與法律風險，可能對營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
產業集中度提高及客戶羣集中度提高，可能導致競爭加劇，並對營運成果造成損害。
本公司之併購、策略聯盟、合資企業、內部重整及資產處分，可能導致財務結果與預期不同。
若無法以可接受條件完成併購，可能對成長率與財務表現造成負面影響。
本公司目前有未償還債務，未來亦可能產生其他債務，可能對財務狀況、流動性及營運成果造成不利影響。
外匯匯率波動可能對我們的財務結果造成不利影響。
我們的有效稅率可能因業務組成變化或稅法立法環境變化而受到不利影響。
若稅法或稅收優惠發生變更或失效，我們的所得稅可能顯著增加。
若我們因重大事故（包括因氣候變遷影響所導致的事故）而遭受工廠、設施或配送系統的損失，我們的營運可能受到顯著影響。
本公司於財務年度2040年實現淨零排放的承諾，將面臨重大成本與規範，可能影響營運、作業流程、營收與聲譽。
第三方可能聲稱我們侵權其智慧財產權，我們可能面臨重大訴訟或授權費用，或被阻止銷售解決方案或服務。
第三方可能侵權我們的智慧財產權，我們可能遭受競爭傷害，或必須投入大量資源執行我們的智慧財產權。
若我們遭遇重大網路安全攻擊或資訊科技系統的中斷，或我們的產品遭受影響，我們的營運、聲譽與營運結果可能受到不利影響。
本公司業務面臨與使用人工智能工具相關之風險。
若本公司無法留住並聘請關鍵人員，將導致業務受損。
若本公司未能維持符合特定法規之滿意程度，可能面臨重大負面財務後果及民事或刑事處罰。
paragraphs: 本公司業務對總體經濟條件的負面變化相當敏感，無論是在美國國內或國際上。全球及區域經濟的波動與不確定性、通貨膨脹以及潛在的經濟衰退，已經並可能持續影響本公司業務，導致：
•製造產品或提供解決方案的成本增加；•客戶購買力下降；
•對本公司解決方案及服務的需求減少，以及訂單減少、延遲或取消；•過多或陳舊存貨的風險增加；
•供應鏈短缺的風險增加；•本公司解決方案及服務的價格壓力增加；以及
•未來投資組合價值減損的風險增加，並對流動性造成不利影響。

此外，全球及區域總體經濟發展，例如對未來經濟活動的不確定性、關稅率提高及相互關稅、財務及資本市場的波動、信貸取得減少、利率變動、流動性下降、國家選舉的不確定性或動盪以及對選舉結果的反應、美國、英國、歐洲及亞洲地區的政治暴力與動盪，以及這些地區總體經濟條件的負面變化或波動，可能會對本公司在這些地區進行業務的能力產生負面影響。本公司供應商及客戶因經濟波動而遭遇的財務困難，可能會導致產品延遲、購買力下降、付款延遲或無法付款，以及存貨問題。與應收帳款相關的經濟風險，可能會導致收款延遲及壞帳費用增加。
